summary: US goes up 7-0 over El Salvador by half-timeWin secures spot at 2027 World Cup and 2028 OlympicsThe United States’ place at a Women’s World Cup is treated as a foregone conclusion, but Friday’s all-or-nothing qualifier against El Salvador gave some reason for nerves.
Given the global advances in women’s soccer over the years, maybe El Salvador could spring an all-time upset.The suspense ultimately lasted for eight minutes and 20 seconds.
With the win, the US maintains their perfect Women’s World Cup attendance record, a part of all 10 tournaments to date.

stories.title: Why have things started to go wrong for Manchester City under Enzo Maresca?
summary: After guilty verdicts were returned regarding the breaking of Premier League financial rules, Enzo Maresca’s team went to Anfield and handed Liverpool a 3-0 schooling.
City have since managed one league victory (3-2 over Ipswich, six days later) and two more wins in regulation time (in the Champions League) in 10 matches.

But it is also fair to ponder whether, after the adrenaline surge of an us-against-the-world mentality carried City to the Liverpool and Ipswich wins, the grim reality of what the guilty verdict may mean for careers is affecting players.
